purpose: Concede an exceptional case or emphasize even a minimum.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Even a king cannot escape the law.
I have not forgotten it for even a single day.
Even if we regret it now, it will not return.
restrictions: Modern formal use often resembles でも or といえども.
mistake: Its literary tone makes it unsuitable as a routine replacement for ても.
